name: Transfer Unmatched Reason 3 Code
definition: Specifies the reason the transaction, transfer or settlement instruction is unmatched.

CMIS.name: No Match
CMIS.definition: No potential match has been found.

DELN.name: Transaction Direction
DELN.definition: Direction of transaction does not match: delivery instead of receipt or vice versa.

DSEC.name: Financial Instrument
DSEC.definition: Financial instrument identification does not match or a financial instrument attribute differs.

PHYS.name: Physical Settlement
PHYS.definition: Settlement does not match: counterparty's instruction is for physical settlement, your instruction is not, or vice versa.

PODU.name: Duplicate
PODU.definition: Instruction has not been matched: it is a possible duplicate instruction.

DEPT.name: Settlement Place
DEPT.definition: Place of settlement does not match.

DDAT.name: Settlement Date
DDAT.definition: Settlement date or transfer date does not match.

DQUA.name: Financial Instrument Quantity
DQUA.definition: Financial instrument quantity does not match.

ICUS.name: Receiving Or Delivering Custodian
ICUS.definition: Delivering or receiving custodian does not match.

SAFE.name: Safekeeping Account
SAFE.definition: Safekeeping account used as a matching criteria on the market concerned does not match.
